summary: Mangala, the Moon's one-year yogini, is a benefic period of comfort, devotion, fame and gains, with auspicious events at home and growth of learning.
rare_outcomes: gift of a conveyance from a ruler or government (Mansagari, Kursija)

by_area.relationships: Happiness from spouse / company of the opposite sex.
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to dharma, gods and teachers.

strengtheners: Moon exalted, in moolatrikona, own or friendly sign (Mansagari)
Moon well placed and unafflicted (Chugh)
sub-period of a benefic yogini (Chugh: benefic-benefic very good)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon combust, debilitated or in an enemy sign (Mansagari: period becomes middling)
Moon weak or afflicted (Chugh)
sub-period of a malefic yogini (Chugh: benefic main with malefic sub = bad tending to neutral)
lagna_or_context_notes: Mansagari judges the period by the yogini's name (four benefic, four malefic) and by its planet's dignity. Chugh: results are modified by the strength and placement of the yogini's planet, including in divisional charts; apply the usual Vimshottari checks to it, and blend yogini and Vimshottari results before predicting; the end of one 36-year cycle and start of the next marks a turning point. Kursija instead says yogini periods should be predicted from the planets' natural results, not from house lordship. Goel (K.N. Rao's group) reads each period through the nakshatra that 'contributes' it: the sign holding that nakshatra is a progressed lagna, and the condition of that nakshatra's lord is judged in the natal and progressed charts. Jhanji: judge the period lord from the house in question and its significator, as alternative lagnas.

disagreements: Mapping: BPHS 46.197-198 and the main Mansagari verse give Moon for Mangala; a variant cited in Mansagari ('of some') swaps Dhanya to Mercury and Bhadrika to Jupiter, and assigns Ketu at the end of Sankata (Jhanji: some give Sankata's first half to Rahu and second half to Ketu). Durations 1-8 years (36 total) agree across BPHS 46.200, Mansagari v.5 and all modern sources. Kursija's English for Pingala says 'free from' the diseases, contradicting the Mansagari Sanskrit and Hindi. Chugh lets the planet's placement modify results; Kursija says predict by natural results only.
phrasing_guidance: Describe the yogini as the tone of a period of 1 year and always say the planet's condition and the running Vimshottari dasha shape how it shows. Keep it encouraging without promising specific gains.
